hero.headline: EXPECT THE *UNEXPECTED*
hero.subtitle: Visuals that tell a story with emotions.
hero.aboutText:
Hi, I’m Himanshu Thakur, a visual storyteller who believes in creating emotions, not just videos.

With a commerce background, I studied at Shemford School in Kashipur and P.N.G. P.G. College in Ramnagar. I also spent two years working in the corporate world, where I learned a lot—but I realized I wanted to build a life around work that felt more creative and meaningful.

That journey led me to video creation: a way to tell stories, connect with people, and make every frame feel something. I believe life can take unexpected turns, and that’s what makes the journey exciting.

Expect the unexpected.

personalSection.title: MASAAN - SERIES
personalSection.subtitle: A Folk Horror / Psychological Thriller
personalSection.genre: Folk Horror, Supernatural Horror, Psychological Thriller, Mystery & Drama
personalSection.description:
MASAAN is a folk-horror psychological thriller rooted in the mysterious beliefs, supernatural folklore and haunting atmosphere of rural Uttarakhand.

The story explores the thin boundary between reality and the supernatural, bringing together friendship, fear, unexplained occurrences and an unsettling mystery. Through atmospheric storytelling, traditional elements and psychological tension, the film gradually unfolds a narrative where everything may not be as it appears.

Blending supernatural horror with emotional depth and suspense, MASAAN explores themes of loss, mystery, friendship and the unknown. Its narrative builds towards a disturbing revelation that challenges the audience's perception of reality.
